title: 13号星期五停飞：达菲前通讯主任不喊惨，两党能否借机推进空管现代化？
speaker: Mark Bednar

segments.en: And Mark, we're told that there were no big national security concerns with this ground stop that no passengers were at risk that it wasn't a cyber attack. But in a former life, you were once communications director for a then congressman, now transportation secretary Sean
segments.zh: 马克，我们得知这次停飞没有重大国家安全担忧，乘客没有风险，也不是网络攻击。但你以前曾担任时任国会议员、现任交通部长肖恩·达菲的通讯主任。

segments.en: Duffy. One of the criticisms is that we didn't hear from the secretary early enough on as this process was going, right? We heard a couple hours later from the White House. The communications
segments.zh: 批评之一是，在这个过程中我们听到部长发声不够早，对吧？几小时后我们才听到白宫的消息。沟通

segments.en: have been more frequent now, but they're not very specific. What is going on behind the scenes and are they giving enough details to the American public?
segments.zh: 现在沟通更频繁了，但不太具体。幕后发生了什么？他们给美国公众提供了足够细节吗？

segments.en: Well, when you have something that of this magnitude to occur, of course, it's very important to get as many facts as you can before you go out there and just say,
segments.zh: 当发生如此重大的事件时，当然，在出去说之前尽可能多地掌握事实非常重要，

segments.en: oh, we're awaiting details, we're awaiting details, we're awaiting details because that doesn't do the public any good. So the fact that Secretary Duffy, Secretary Mullen,
segments.zh: 哦，我们等待细节，等待细节，等待细节，因为这对公众没有好处。所以达菲部长、马伦部长，

segments.en: that they've been actually going step by step methodically, while also bringing the FAA into the discussion here to find out not only what happened, but to have that paper trail of,
segments.zh: 他们实际上在一步步有条不紊地推进，同时让联邦航空局参与讨论，不仅查明发生了什么，还留下书面记录，

segments.en: here's actually what happened. We cornerstone, we corner what actually occurred here.
segments.zh: 这里实际发生了什么。我们确定，我们确认了实际发生的情况。

segments.en: And by the way, here are some different policy remedies that we can actually approach on a bipartisan basis. I actually think that despite, you know, this occurrence, this is actually a spot to
segments.zh: 顺便说一句，这里有一些我们可以两党合作推进的不同政策补救措施。实际上我认为，尽管发生了这件事，这其实是一个机会，

segments.en: Adam's point of, you know, how we say Democrats are coming in with a specific agenda.
segments.zh: 亚当的观点，即我们如何说民主党人带着具体议程而来。

segments.en: This could actually be a really good opportunity for Republicans and Democrats to come together to basically help build out modernize our air traffic control system, modernize our travel in a way
segments.zh: 这实际上可能是共和党和民主党合作的好机会，基本上帮助建设和现代化我们的空中交通管制系统，以某种方式现代化我们的旅行

segments.en: that actually, you know, benefits our whole economy, benefits different regions of the country.
segments.zh: 这实际上有利于整体经济，也有利于不同地区。

segments.en: So while this is, of course, you know, something that nobody really wanted to occur, of course, on Friday the 13th of all days. This actually, I think, opens a window of opportunity here.
segments.zh: 虽然这是没人希望发生的，尤其是在13号星期五。但我认为这打开了机会窗口。
